notes: Master: all 120 programmes of UCPH's official master's catalogue recorded (the page states a total of 120). These are the programmes a non-EU/EEA applicant can be considered for; the official pages do not say which of them carry a Danish Government Scholarship in a given year, so the list is the pool, not a confirmed award list.

Some listed programmes are taught partly or wholly in Danish, are offered in China, are work-integrated or combined programmes, or are Erasmus Mundus programmes with their own funding rules; the catalogue page does not mark the teaching language. Check the programme page.
